entries.before: Both MP4 parsers (src/container/mp4.rs and crates/fvid-media/src/owned_mp4_impl.rs) accept overlapping stco chunk spans, backward co64 chunk offsets, zero-byte stsz samples, zero-byte trun samples, empty non-fragmented tracks, and empty fragmented tracks, allowing corrupted sample tables to alias media bytes across chunks, emit empty coded packets, or expose 0-sample tracks.
entries.result: Reject overlapping or non-increasing chunk offsets in chunk_runs, zero-byte samples in expanded_index and index_fragments, and 0-sample tracks in sample_index and index_fragments across both MP4 parsers. Two multi-chunk stco/co64 controls decode 3 exact VP9 packets and 16x16 RGB frames across sequential playback, EOF, rewind, and seek; six malformed inputs refuse as Error::Invalid. 2 focused/46 related integrations, 18 MP4 units, 359 core checks, fixture unittest and player build pass.

entries.title: Enforce Matroska BlockGroup singleton Block, reserved block flags, and deterministic equal-PTS/pre-origin seek
entries.before: WebmReader accepts BlockGroup (0xa0) elements lacking Block (0xa1) or containing duplicate Block elements and accepts reserved flag bits in SimpleBlock (0x70) and Block (0x71); WebmVideoReader::seek_to_sync uses >= on keyframe timestamps so equal-PTS invisible setup keyframes are skipped and VP9 show-existing frames fail; WebmAudioReader::seek uses >= on equal-PTS packets and falls back to (0, 0) on pre-origin seeks.
entries.result: Reject BlockGroup without exactly one Block and reject reserved flag bits in SimpleBlock/Block; select the first keyframe/packet at a shared PTS in WebmVideoReader::seek_to_sync and WebmAudioReader::seek, and scan to the first packet of self.track_number on pre-origin audio seeks. Three healthy controls preserve exact VP9 planes, BlockGroup timing, and PCM packets; four malformed inputs refuse as Error::Invalid. 2 focused/7 related integrations, 10 WebM units, 359 core checks, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Reject duplicate AVI headers, partial idx1 entries, and clamp delayed-start PCM/G.711 seek landing
entries.before: Avi::parse accepts duplicate avih chunks in hdrl, duplicate strh/strf chunks in LIST strl, and partial trailing entries in idx1 when (index.end - index.start) % 16 != 0; AviAudioReader::seek_to returns 0 instead of dwStart when seeking before the first sample of a delayed-start PCM/G.711 stream.
entries.result: Reject duplicate avih, strh, and strf chunks and non-16-byte-multiple idx1 chunks in Avi::parse/check_index, and clamp PCM/G.711 seek targets to [start, end] in AviAudioReader::seek_to. Delayed-start PCM control lands on sample 100 before start, slices exact frames at sample 106, and reaches EOF at sample 108; four malformed inputs refuse as Error::Invalid. 2 focused/3 related integrations, 34 AVI units, 359 core checks, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Reject reserved Ogg page flags, spurious mid-stream/empty continuations, unended chained Vorbis links, and report selected Opus track index
entries.before: Ogg::parse accepts non-zero reserved bits in header_type_flag (flags & !0x07 != 0), ignores CONTINUES on 0-segment pages when no packet is open, and silently discards completed packets when a mid-stream page sets CONTINUES without an open packet; owned_ogg_vorbis::Program accepts chained Vorbis links where the previous link never set EOS; OggOpusAudioReader::audio_track_index() returns 0 even when track 1 is selected.
entries.result: Reject reserved header_type_flag bits and spurious 0-segment or mid-stream CONTINUES flags in Ogg::parse, enforce EOS on preceding links in owned_ogg_vorbis::Program::from_ogg, and expose audio_track_index() on owned_ogg_opus::Program and OggOpusAudioReader. Three healthy controls (2-track parallel Opus, 0-segment continuation bridge, and 2-link chained Vorbis) preserve exact PCM, track indices, and worker seek/EOF; five malformed inputs refuse as Error::Invalid. 2 focused/43 related integrations, 8 Ogg/Vorbis units, 359 core checks, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Enforce WAV extensible cbSize/channel-mask bounds, AIFC G.711 8-bit sample width, and AuAudioReader::present_decoded parity
entries.before: WAV parse_fmt accepts WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE headers whose cbSize exceeds body.len() - 18 or whose dwChannelMask names more speaker positions than channels; AIFC parse_comm accepts alaw/ulaw compression with 16/24/32-bit sampleSize; AuAudioReader omits present_decoded and presentation_floor, accepting negative source_pts and unaligned decoded payloads without stamping timebase or trimming pre-seek frames.
entries.result: Validate usize::from(cbSize) <= body.len() - 18 and channel_mask.count_ones() <= channels in WAV parse_fmt, require bits == 8 for AIFC G.711 in parse_comm, and implement present_decoded + presentation_floor on AuAudioReader matching WavAudioReader and AiffAudioReader. Three healthy WAV/AIFC/AU controls and four malformed inputs pass; 3 focused integrations, 56 WAV/AIFF/AU units, 359 core checks, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Enforce FLAC STREAMINFO ordering, exact length, block/frame size bounds, reserved metadata rejection, and speaker-mask channel bounds
entries.before: Head::read accepts non-STREAMINFO first metadata blocks, duplicate or overlong STREAMINFO blocks, reserved metadata block types (7..=127), and invalid STREAMINFO block-size bounds (min_block < 16 or min_block > max_block); Flac::parse_owned_controlled ignores nonzero max_frame mismatches when min_frame == 0 and accepts Vorbis-comment speaker masks whose popcount exceeds channels (as do owned_flac_decoder and WebmAudioReader).
entries.result: Require STREAMINFO (type 0, exact 34 bytes) at byte 4, reject duplicate STREAMINFO and reserved metadata block types (7..=127), validate min_block/max_block >= 16 and min_block <= max_block across bare and Matroska FLAC setup, verify nonzero max_frame independently of min_frame, and enforce channel_mask.count_ones() <= channels across bare FLAC and Matroska FLAC. Two healthy bare/Matroska controls and ten malformed inputs pass; 2 focused/11 related integrations, 24 FLAC units, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Enforce SMF End-of-Track termination, XM unpacked note clamping and 16-bit sample/pattern bounds, and SMF/XM present_decoded validation
entries.before: SMF parse_track returns Ok(tick) when an MTrk chunk ends without an End-of-Track (FF 2F) meta event; XM read_cell leaves out-of-range notes > 97 unclamped in unpacked cells, parse_patterns reads cells across the pattern data boundary before checking cursor > end, and parse_instruments accepts odd byte lengths for 16-bit samples; SmfAudioReader::present_decoded and XmAudioReader::present_decoded accept negative source_pts and unaligned PCM frame payloads.
entries.result: Require Meta::End (FF 2F) before returning from SMF parse_track, clamp unpacked XM cell notes > NOTE_KEY_OFF to 0, slice pattern data to &bytes[data..end] before reading cells, reject odd data_bytes on 16-bit XM samples, and validate source_pts >= 0 and stereo float32 frame alignment in SmfAudioReader::present_decoded and XmAudioReader::present_decoded. Four healthy SMF/XM controls and three malformed inputs pass; 4 focused/6 related integrations, 38 SMF/XM units, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Enforce WavPack APEv2 header/footer flags and subblock header completeness, MP3 present_decoded validation without gapless/seek state, and AC-3 open_mode file budget
entries.before: WavPack Input::tags accepts APEv2 footers with no_footer (0x40000000) set or mismatched APEv2 header flags, and Block::parse silently ignores 1..3 trailing bytes at the end of a WavPack block when a metadata item header is truncated; Mp3AudioReader::present_decoded bypasses negative source_pts, channel-frame stride alignment, and PTS/timebase stamping when neither gapless metadata nor seek floor is active; Ac3AudioReader::open_mode lacks an explicit bytes.len() > limits.file_bytes guard before parsing.
entries.result: Reject APEv2 footers with flags & 0x60000000 != 0 or header flags != (flags | 0x20000000) in Input::tags, reject 1..3-byte truncated metadata item headers in Block::parse, always validate source_pts >= 0 and stride alignment and stamp PTS/timebase in Mp3AudioReader::present_decoded, and check bytes.len() > limits.file_bytes in Ac3AudioReader::open_mode. Healthy WavPack/MP3/AC-3 controls and four malformed WavPack inputs pass; 2 focused/3 related integrations, 19 unit tests, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Enforce FLAC STREAMINFO frame/block bounds in FlacDecoder, MP2 sample-rate and finite-PCM guards, stereo IMA WAV block alignment, XM row channel count and ignored-counter reset, and MIDI rendered-frame reset
entries.before: FlacDecoder::new ignores STREAMINFO min_frame > max_frame when max_frame != 0 and FlacDecoder::decode_encoded accepts frames exceeding STREAMINFO max_block; fvid_codecs::mp2::Decoder::new accepts arbitrary non-zero sample rates outside MPEG Layer II and omits finite checks on narrowed f32 PCM samples; adpcm_decoder::frames_of accepts stereo CODEC_ID_ADPCM_IMA_WAV blocks whose payload is not a multiple of 8 bytes; XmDecoder::decode_encoded accepts row packets whose cell count disagrees with module.channels and XmDecoder::reset leaves row-accumulated Ignored counters dirty; MidiDecoder::reset leaves self.rendered nonzero across resets.
entries.result: Validate min_frame <= max_frame (when max_frame != 0) in FlacDecoder::new and frame.frames <= max_block in FlacDecoder::decode_encoded, restrict fvid_codecs::mp2::Decoder::new to the 9 MPEG Layer II sample rates and reject non-finite narrowed f32 output samples, require 8-byte stereo payload alignment for CODEC_ID_ADPCM_IMA_WAV in adpcm_decoder::frames_of, require row.cells.len() == self.voices.len() in XmDecoder::decode_encoded and restore self.ignored = self.initial_ignored in XmDecoder::reset, and reset self.rendered = 0 in MidiDecoder::reset. Three focused integration tests, 3 MP2 integration tests, FLAC/ADPCM/XM/MIDI unit suites, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Initialize expanded FFV1 v3 non-keyframe range context tables from QuantizationSet::initial and enforce symmetric AV1 4:2:0 film-grain chroma point-count conformance
entries.before: FFV1 v3 Configuration::change_quantizers initializes expanded range-coder context tables (grow[i] == true) with [0; 32] (zero probability, causing Range::bit to emit false without reading or renormalizing the bitstream) instead of self.sets[selected[i]].initial, corrupting non-keyframe slices that switch to a larger quantizer set; AV1 Grain::parse only rejects 4:2:0 film grain when point_counts[1] == 0 && point_counts[2] != 0, missing the symmetric AV1 6.8.20 conformance violation point_counts[1] != 0 && point_counts[2] == 0.
entries.result: Populate expanded range context banks in Configuration::change_quantizers from self.sets[selected[i]].initial matching Configuration::state_for, and reject (g.point_counts[1] == 0) != (g.point_counts[2] == 0) for 4:2:0 chroma in AV1 Grain::parse. Two focused integration tests (with synthetic FFV1 v3 and AV1 fixtures), 17 FFV1/AV1 unit tests, no-default-features integration check, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Account for Picture::Packed/Vp9/Av1 bytes in WebmVideoReader reorder queue, allow deferred in-band HEVC parameter sets in Matroska, and return None from MP4 NativeReader::current_pts before frame 1
entries.before: WebmVideoReader::next_decoded ignores Picture::Packed, Picture::Vp9, and Picture::Av1 in reorder queue memory accounting (`_ => {}`), allowing reordered PackedPlanar frames (non-4:2:0/GBR AVC and software HEVC) to bypass queue_budget; WebmVideoReader::open_with_hardware requires complete hvcC parameter arrays at open and calls HevcDecoder::parameters() in bitstream_colour() and advance(), rejecting or panicking on Matroska HEVC streams whose VPS/SPS/PPS arrive in-band after packet 0; NativeReader::current_pts returns Some((0, timescale)) on NativeReader::Avc before any frame is read or after rewind().
entries.result: Charge Picture::Packed (frame.data + alpha), Picture::Vp9, and Picture::Av1 plane storage in WebmVideoReader::next_decoded, open Matroska HEVC with HevcDecoder::from_inband_configuration and query d.try_parameters() in bitstream_colour() and advance(), and return None from NativeReader::current_pts when *frames == 0 on NativeReader::Avc. Two focused integration tests, 13 related Matroska/AVC/HEVC integration tests, 44 playback unit tests, 359 minimal-core tests, fixture unittest and binary build pass.

entries.title: Skip multi-line WebVTT NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks, fold case-insensitive SAMI   caption clears, scope ASS Dialogue lines to [Events], and reject negative Spool seeks
entries.before: subtitles::parse_webvtt delegates directly to cues_by_range without skipping NOTE, STYLE, and REGION paragraphs, parsing CSS comments or commented-out cues containing `-->` as active subtitle cues; subtitles::parse_sami replaces only lowercase ` ` with U+00A0, causing uppercase `&NBSP;` or mixed-case `&Nbsp;` in `<Sync>` clearing paragraphs to render literal `&NBSP;` instead of clearing the caption; subtitles::parse_ass reads `Dialogue:` lines outside the `[Events]` section; and playback_spool::Spool::seek silently clamps negative result positions to 0 via saturating_sub instead of returning ErrorKind::InvalidInput.
entries.result: Skip NOTE, STYLE, and REGION paragraphs until the next blank line in parse_webvtt, match ` ` ASCII case-insensitively in SAMI line_breaks, restrict parse_ass `Dialogue:` scanning to `[Events]`, and reject negative target offsets in Spool::seek with io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput matching Backing::Ram::seek and std::io::Seek. Four focused integration tests, 33 subtitle unit tests, 5 spool unit tests, and 2 offline fixture generator tests pass.

entries.title: Reject non-finite .3dl values and inverted .cube/.spi1d domains, check all 1D LUT entries in Lut::is_identity, and reject degenerate or zero-luminance MasteringDisplay volumes
entries.before: Lut::from_3dl accepts NaN and inf in mesh and node lines because f32::NAN.clamp(0.0, 1.0) remains NaN; Lut::from_cube and Lut::from_spi1d accept non-finite or inverted input domains (DOMAIN_MIN >= DOMAIN_MAX, LUT_1D/3D_INPUT_RANGE, From); Lut::is_identity on Lut::One probes only 17 grey steps, causing Grade::apply to skip 1D LUTs modified between the 17 probes; MasteringDisplay::from_corners and from_payload accept y == 0.0, collinear primaries (such as an all-zero 24-byte placeholder MDCV box), max_luminance == 0.0, and min_luminance > max_luminance, poisoning Primaries::rgb_to_xyz and Grade::new with NaN.
entries.result: Require f32::is_finite on .3dl numeric tokens, validate finite min < max input domains in Lut::from_cube and Lut::from_spi1d, check every entry of all three channels against its domain ramp in Lut::is_identity for Lut::One, and require y > 0.0, x + y <= 1.0, non-collinear primaries with finite rgb_to_xyz/xyz_to_rgb matrices, max_luminance > 0.0, and min_luminance <= max_luminance in MasteringDisplay::from_corners. Four focused integration tests, 69 root color unit tests, 68 fvid-codecs color unit tests, and 5 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Mark playback worker ended on seek/rewind EOF or error, synchronize seek packet cache, route ASS files containing '-->' to parse_ass scoped to [Events], and prevent coordinate/dimension overflow in play controls
entries.before: Worker::drain_commands in src/playback/runtime/thread.rs clears self.ended = false on Command::Seek and Command::Rewind but fails to set self.ended = true when reader.seek_raw returns Ok(None) or Err(error) or when reader.rewind returns Err(error), and fails to update self.indexed_count in stage(), causing Worker::run to immediately invoke decode_next() in the same generation after emitting a terminal seek/rewind event; crates/fvid-media/src/owned_play_controls_impl.rs misroutes ASS subtitle files containing `-->` in comments or dialogue text to parse_srt, scans Dialogue: lines outside [Events], overflows i32 coordinates in blit_bitmap_subtitle, overflows u32 width * height in detect_letterbox_bars, waveform_column_fills, apply_box_denoise_pixel, and apply_unsharp_pixel, and can round fit_window_to_video / locked_window_size above max_w / max_h.
entries.result: Set self.ended = true and synchronize cache_packets/indexed_count on seek/rewind EOF or error in src/playback/runtime/thread.rs; detect ASS headers before checking `-->` in parse_subtitle_text, scope parse_ass Dialogue: lines to [Events], widen coordinates to i64 with checked pixel counts in blit_bitmap_subtitle, use usize::checked_mul in pixel/scope helpers, and clamp fit_window_to_video and locked_window_size to max_w/max_h. Four focused integration tests, 5 playback_thread unit tests, and 3 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Support dot-separated SRT timestamps, trailing cue coordinates, uppercase HTML entities, and spaced/millisecond ASS cues in native subtitle conversion, reject negative drawbox/drawgrid thickness with quote-aware option parsing, and reserve f64 resampler history fallibly
entries.before: owned_subtitle_impl::timestamp rejects dot-separated SRT fractional seconds (`00:00:01.000`), try_convert_srt rejects SRT timing lines with trailing coordinate/style tokens (`X1:100 ...`), ass_text matches HTML entities (`&`, `&NBSP;`, etc.) case-sensitively, and try_convert_ass rejects 1- or 3-digit fractional seconds or spaced/case-insensitive `Format :` / `Dialogue :` lines; owned_draw::Draw::parse splits options on `:` without respecting quotes, fails to unquote double-quoted values, accepts negative thickness `t < 0`, and can overflow `left + w` in `Draw::selected`; owned_resample_f64::Resampler::write pushes to `self.queue` without `try_reserve(1)`.
entries.result: Accept `,` and `.` in `timestamp`, strip trailing whitespace tokens after the end timestamp in `try_convert_srt`, fold HTML entity names ASCII case-insensitively in `ass_text`, support 1..=3 fractional digits and case-insensitive/spaced `Format`/`Dialogue` keys in `try_convert_ass`, add quote-aware option splitting/unquoting, negative-thickness rejection, and saturating/widened coordinate arithmetic in `owned_draw::Draw`, and call `self.queue.try_reserve(1)` before `push_back` in `owned_resample_f64`. Four focused integration tests, 4 unit tests, and 3 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Admit AVI and WavPack in player folder expansion and file dialogs, strip playlist quotes and INI headers, bound LUT/playlist/skin file reads, and guard negative subtitle delay and zero-size video_rect
entries.before: playable_path and pick_file omit `.avi`, `.wv`, and `.wvc` (and pick_file omits `.m4v` and `.sami`), causing directory queue expansion to skip AVI and WavPack files that NativeReader and AUDIO_READERS support; parse_playlist treats PLS `[playlist]` section headers as relative paths and does not strip surrounding quotes on M3U/PLS file entries; read_lut, expand_inputs, and player_skin::Skin::load read whole files into memory with unbounded std::fs::read_to_string; Player::subtitle_line computes `at + shift` without overflow protection when subtitle_delay_ms < 0; and video_rect divides by zero when size.x <= 0.0 or size.y <= 0.0.
entries.result: Include `avi`, `wv`, and `wvc` in playable_path and pick_file (plus `m4v` and `sami` in pick_file), skip `[section]` headers and strip matching outer quotes in parse_playlist, bound read_lut (16 MiB), expand_inputs (4 MiB), and Skin::load (64 KiB) via File::open(...).take(...), use `at.checked_add(shift)?` in Player::subtitle_line, and return a zero-sized finite centered Rect from video_rect when frame or size dimensions are non-positive. One focused integration test, 4 player/skin unit tests, and 3 offline fixture generator tests pass.

entries.title: Emit filter steps for all 48 supported lossless pixel filters and framestep, reject unimplemented zscale in native_lossless::supports, and account for geometry.rotate in transformed_aspect and RotateAngle::size
entries.before: native_plan::transcode_lossless checks only 19 of the 48 pixel filters executed by PixelFilters::apply_colour_clock, emitting zero `filter` steps when any of the other 29 filters (tmix, hqdn3d, smartblur, sab, cas, vignette, curves, colorbalance, colorlevels, colorchannelmixer, monochrome, grayworld, drawbox, drawgrid, lagfun, bitplanenoise, deband, gradfun, lenscorrection, removegrain, yaepblur, vibrance, colorize, exposure, colorcontrast, colorcorrect, lutyuv, colorhold, perspective) is used, and rejects supported framestep requests; native_lossless::supports matches `zscale: _` and silently drops zscale in configuration(); and native_export::transformed_aspect ignores geometry.rotate while RotateAngle::size computes inexact floating-point sin_cos at 90/180/270-degree multiples.
entries.result: List all 48 supported pixel filters in canonical execution order plus framestep in native_plan::transcode_lossless, require `zscale: None` in native_lossless::supports, update transformed_aspect to apply geometry.rotate canvas dimensions and 90/270-degree aspect swaps before pad/scale, and use exact cardinal sin/cos in RotateAngle::size matching owned_rotate::rotate_rgb_fill. Three focused integration tests, 3 fvid-media-info unit tests, and 2 offline fixture generator tests pass.

entries.title: Unify Matroska probe codec/metadata/disposition parity, apply container PixelCrop* insets on identity decode and Y4M export, and report canonical bit-depth-qualified PCM codec names in audio_source_info_selected
entries.before: native_probe::matroska returns raw Matroska CodecIDs for A_PCM/INT/LIT, A_PCM/INT/BIG, A_PCM/FLOAT/IEEE, A_ALAC, and A_MPEG/L1, drops file-level custom SimpleTags (`reader.metadata`) and `reader.writing_app` encoder fallback, ignores track-scoped metadata (`reader.track_metadata`) and `reader.track_languages`, and hardcodes `disposition: 0`; native_media::decode_video_pipeline_overlay_step skips `apply_cropped_display` when `geometry.is_identity() && filters.is_empty() && compositor.is_none()` and native_export::export_y4m_sources / PixelFilters::configure_vignette_source ignore `reader.insets()` altogether; and native_media::audio_source_info_selected reports non-canonical `pcm_sle`, `pcm_sbe`, and `pcm_fle` instead of bit-depth-qualified `pcm_s16le`..`pcm_f64le`.
entries.result: Map Matroska PCM bit depths, A_ALAC, and A_MPEG/L1 in `media_probe::matroska` alongside custom file/track metadata, WritingApp encoder fallback, track_languages, and track_dispositions; apply `reader.insets()` and visible post-inset dimensions in `decode_video_pipeline_overlay_step`, `export_y4m_sources`, and `PixelFilters::configure_vignette_source`; and return canonical bit-depth-qualified PCM codec strings in `audio_source_info_selected`. Three focused integration tests, 45 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture generator test pass.

entries.title: Dispatch Matroska FLAC and MPEG audio in owned_container_loudness, propagate explicit speaker masks for Matroska Opus/FLAC/ALAC/PCM plan and export rematrixing, default QuickTime 0-bit sowt/twos to 16-bit in owned_mp4_probe, and negotiate in-band PS in native_pcm::loudness
entries.before: owned_container_loudness::decode_to_wave admits Matroska FLAC (`flac`) and MPEG audio (`mp1`, `mp2`, `mp3`) in `geometry` / `supports` / `plan_loudness`, then falls into `decode_matroska_pcm_f64` and fails with `selected Matroska audio stream is not PCM`; `owned_audio_plan::matroska_descriptor` fabricates `standard_mask(channels)` for Matroska Opus and multichannel (>2ch) PCM instead of `OpusHead::wave_channel_mask()` and `0`, while `owned_audio_export` and Matroska Opus/FLAC/ALAC/PCM exporters admit `mask == 0` multichannel rematrixing; `owned_mp4_probe_impl` formats QuickTime `sowt`/`twos` with omitted sample size (`bit_depth == 0`) as `pcm_s0le`/`pcm_s0be`; and `native_pcm::loudness::measure_file_controlled` omits `negotiate_mp4_ps`, `negotiate_matroska_ps`, and `negotiate_adts_aac_reader`, failing with `channel weights must match selected audio stream` on implicit/in-band PS sources.
entries.result: Dispatch `flac` to `decode_matroska_flac_pcm` and `mp1`/`mp2`/`mp3` to `decode_matroska_mpeg_pcm` in `owned_container_loudness::decode_to_wave`; use `owned_matroska_opus_export::geometry_with_mask` (`OpusHead::wave_channel_mask()`) and `0` for >2ch Matroska PCM in `matroska_descriptor`, and require `mask != 0` when rematrixing >2ch streams in `owned_audio_plan`, `owned_audio_export`, and Matroska Opus/FLAC/ALAC/PCM exporters; default `bit_depth == 0` on `sowt`/`twos` to 16-bit in `owned_mp4_probe_impl`; and negotiate in-band PS (with boxed `NegotiatedAdts`) in `native_pcm::loudness::measure_file_controlled`. Four focused integration tests, 10 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture generator test pass.

entries.title: Enforce WAVE non-zero PCM padding bit rejection across owned audio export, loudness, and loudnorm, add G.711 WAVE and Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint support to owned_audio_plan and owned_audio_mix, and enforce rematrix speaker-mask and controlled-budget admission in Ogg Vorbis/Joint and bare FLAC/MP3 exporters
entries.before: read_wave_with_admission in owned_audio_mix.rs and measure_for_normalization in owned_wave_loudness.rs silently ignore non-zero low padding bits in WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE integer PCM (`valid_bits < bits_per_sample`), unlike native_pcm.rs; owned_audio_plan::source_descriptor_for_decode and owned_audio_mix::audio_plan have no branches for G.711 WAVE or Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint inputs, failing on plan_decode_audio, plan_mix_audio, and plan_merge_audio even though decode_audio, mix_audio, and merge_audio decode them natively; owned_ogg_vorbis_export::supports and owned_ogg_joint_export::supports omit explicit speaker-mask validation (`output_channel_mask() != 0 && rematrix_layout_supported(...)`) and check `destination.exists()` instead of `destination.symlink_metadata().is_ok()`; and owned_audio_export::supports calls `geometry().is_ok()` for bare FLAC and MP3, dropping controlled-memory-budget errors and channel-rematrix validation.
entries.result: Reject non-zero low `bits_per_sample - valid_bits` padding bits in `read_wave_with_admission` and `measure_for_normalization`; add G.711 WAVE (`owned_g711_wave_export::descriptor`) and Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint (`owned_ogg_audio_export::descriptor`) handling to `owned_audio_plan` and `owned_audio_mix::audio_plan`; require valid speaker masks on >2ch rematrixing and `symlink_metadata().is_ok()` destination checks in `owned_ogg_vorbis_export`, `owned_ogg_joint_export`, and `owned_g711_wave_export`; and add `supports()` with controlled-budget preservation and rematrix layout validation to `owned_raw_flac` and `owned_raw_mp3`. Four focused integration tests, 9 related integration/unit tests, and 2 offline fixture generator tests pass.

entries.title: Add owned and native probe support for G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, and bare FLAC/MPEG audio, extend owned loudness and loudnorm pipelines to G.711 WAVE, Ogg, bare FLAC, and bare MP1/MP2/MP3, reject 0-sample trimmed MPEG streams in planning, and keep ADTS loudness/loudnorm planning configuration-only
entries.before: owned_wave_inspect::inspect rejects G.711 A-law/mu-law WAVE (`WAVE_FORMAT_ALAW=6` and `WAVE_FORMAT_MULAW=7`) with `unsupported WAVE encoding` during `owned_probe::probe` and `native_probe::try_probe_as`; `owned_probe` and `native_probe` fail to recognize or probe Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint (`.ogg`), bare FLAC (`.flac`), or bare MP1/MP2/MP3 (`.mp3`); `owned_container_loudness` and `native_loudnorm` reject G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC, and bare MP1/MP2/MP3 in `plan_loudness`, `measure_loudness`, `plan_loudnorm`, `apply_loudnorm`, `apply_loudnorm_dual`, `native_loudnorm::try_plan`, and `native_loudnorm::try_apply`; `owned_raw_mp3::descriptor` accepts 0-sample Lame-trimmed MPEG streams during `plan_decode_audio` instead of rejecting them upfront; and `owned_adts_loudness::supports_plan` / `plan_loudness` invoke `owned_audio_plan::plan_decode_audio`, which scans ADTS packets via `adts_prefix_info` instead of remaining configuration-only.
entries.result: Support G.711 A-law (`pcm_alaw`) and mu-law (`pcm_mulaw`) in `owned_wave_inspect::inspect` while keeping `validate_pcm_only()` for raw PCM callers; add `owned_flac_probe`, `owned_mpeg_probe`, and Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint probing to `owned_probe` and `src/media_probe.rs` (including Vorbis comment tags and FLAC `WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE_CHANNEL_MASK`); extend `owned_container_loudness` and `native_loudnorm` to decode, measure, and normalize G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC, and bare MP1/MP2/MP3 via private float32 WAVE spooling; reject 0-sample trimmed MPEG streams in `owned_raw_mp3::descriptor`; and construct ADTS loudness/loudnorm plans directly from `validate_configuration` without packet-scanning. Three focused integration tests, 40 related integration tests, and 2 offline fixture generator tests pass.

entries.title: Distinguish G.711 A-law/mu-law WAVE from linear PCM in native_pcm::is_wave, route selected secondary Matroska/MP4 audio codecs (FLAC, Opus, MPEG, ADPCM) to owned fvid_media in media and native_loudnorm, and dispatch owned audio decode/plan/mix/merge in media_cli without legacy features
entries.before: native_pcm::is_wave inspects only the 12-byte RIFF/WAVE header prefix and returns Ok(true) for G.711 A-law (`tag=6`) and mu-law (`tag=7`) WAVE files, causing top-level media::decode_audio, media::plan_decode_audio, media::mix_audio, media::merge_audio, and native_loudnorm to enter native_pcm linear PCM paths and fail with `WAVE trim requires packed integer or IEEE float PCM` instead of routing to fvid_media's owned G.711 WAVE implementation; media::decode_audio_transformed, media::plan_decode_audio, and native_loudnorm::try_plan/try_apply check container-wide `is_owned_audio_trim_source` without checking whether the selected `--streams` track is handled by `native_media::audio_source_info_selected`, failing on secondary Matroska FLAC/Opus/MPEG or MP4 ADPCM tracks in multitrack containers; and media_cli rejects `plan decode-audio`, `decode-audio`, `mix-audio`, and `merge-audio` on owned fvid_media audio formats (Ogg, G.711 WAVE, bare FLAC/MP3, Matroska FLAC/Opus/MPEG, MP4 ADPCM) without `--features media`.
entries.result: Return Ok(false) from `native_pcm::is_wave` for valid RIFF WAVE files with G.711 A-law (`tag=6`) or mu-law (`tag=7`) `fmt ` chunks so top-level media, native_audio_mix, and native_loudnorm delegate G.711 WAVE to fvid_media; check selected stream eligibility (`audio_source_info_selected`) in `media::uses_native_audio_route`, `native_loudnorm::try_plan`, `native_loudnorm::try_apply`, and `media_cli` so secondary Matroska FLAC/Opus/MPEG and MP4 ADPCM streams route to `fvid_media` and `owned_container_loudnorm`; and dispatch `plan decode-audio`, `.wav` `decode-audio`, `plan mix-audio`, `.wav` `mix-audio`, `plan merge-audio`, and `.wav` `merge-audio` through `fvid::media` in `src/media_cli.rs`. Three focused integration tests, 43 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Extend owned and top-level trim, plan_trim, loudness, and constant-gain normalize_loudness across G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC/MP3, and secondary Matroska/MP4 audio tracks, and dispatch them in media_cli without legacy features
entries.before: fvid_media::trim and fvid_media::plan_trim handle only linear PCM WAVE (`owned_wave_remux` / `owned_wave_plan`) and reject G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC/MP3, and secondary Matroska/MP4 audio tracks even though `owned_audio_export` and `owned_audio_plan` support interval trimming to `.wav`/`.mka`/`.mkv`; `media::trim` and `media::plan_trim` enter `native_export::trim_audio_pcm` / `native_plan::trim_audio` whenever `is_owned_audio_trim_source` holds on the container without checking whether a selected `--streams` track is supported by `native_media::audio_source_info_selected`, failing on secondary Matroska FLAC/Opus/MPEG or MP4 ADPCM tracks; `native_pcm::loudness::measure_file_controlled` checks `&prefix[..4] == b"RIFF"` before `is_wave` (failing on G.711 WAVE) and falls through to ADTS (`invalid ADTS header`) for Ogg, bare FLAC/MP3, and secondary Matroska/MP4 codecs; `native_pcm::normalize::normalize_file_controlled` and `native_plan::loudness` fail on those same formats; and `media_cli::try_native_audio_trim` does not route standalone owned audio or secondary container tracks through `fvid::media::plan_trim` and `fvid::media::trim`.
entries.result: Delegate `owned_wave_remux::trim` and `owned_wave_plan::plan_trim` to `owned_audio_export::decode_audio_transformed` and `owned_audio_plan::plan_decode_audio` with `interval: Some((from, to))` when linear PCM WAVE remux is not applicable; check selected stream eligibility (`audio_source_info_selected`) in `media::trim` and `media::plan_trim`; update `native_pcm::loudness`, `native_pcm::normalize`, and `native_plan::loudness` to support G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC/MP3, and secondary Matroska/MP4 audio tracks via `owned_container_loudness::decode_to_wave`, `fvid_media::decode_audio_transformed`, and `fvid_media::plan_decode_audio`; and dispatch `plan trim` and `trim` in `media_cli` through `fvid::media` without requiring `--features media`. Three focused integration tests, 35 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Honor max_controlled_bytes in native_loudnorm and CLI across ADTS, MP4, and Matroska, and extend native_audio_mix, merge_audio, and sample-domain concat_audio across all single-stream owned audio formats
entries.before: native_loudnorm::try_plan and native_loudnorm::try_apply return Ok(None) whenever options.max_controlled_bytes.is_some(), causing `fvid media plan loudnorm` and `fvid media loudnorm` with `--max-memory-mib` on ADTS, MP4, and Matroska inputs to fail in `owned_loudnorm_cli` (`loudnorm input or compressed-audio policy is not yet supported by the owned bridge`) instead of delegating to `owned_adts_loudnorm` and `owned_container_loudnorm`; `native_audio_mix::eligible`, `plan`, `mix_audio`, `plan_merge`, and `merge_audio` accept only linear PCM WAVE and AAC/ALAC/PCM containers handled by `native_media::is_owned_audio_source`, failing on `.mka`/`.mkv` Matroska outputs and `native_audio_mix` calls for G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC/MP3, Matroska FLAC/Opus/MPEG, and MP4 ADPCM; and `native_audio_mix::concat_eligible`, `concat_audio`, `native_plan::concat_mp4_matroska`, and `native_export::try_concat_mp4_matroska` reject sample-domain audio concatenation to `.mka`/`.mkv` when any input is G.711 WAVE, Ogg, bare FLAC/MP3, Matroska FLAC/Opus/MPEG, or MP4 ADPCM.
entries.result: Delegate `native_loudnorm::try_plan` and `native_loudnorm::try_apply` to `fvid_media::owned_adts_loudnorm` and `fvid_media::owned_container_loudnorm` when `options.max_controlled_bytes.is_some()`, preserving controlled-memory-budget admission and execution for ADTS, MP4, and Matroska; add `source_geometry_with_mask` to `owned_audio_plan` and extend `native_audio_mix` (`eligible`, `plan`, `mix_audio`, `plan_merge`, `merge_audio`) to validate and decode single-stream `fvid_media` audio formats (G.711 WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC/MP3, Matroska FLAC/Opus/MPEG, MP4 ADPCM) via private WAVE spooling while rejecting multi-audio containers without explicit selection; and extend `native_audio_mix::concat`, `native_plan::concat_mp4_matroska`, and `native_export::try_concat_mp4_matroska` (`media::probe`) to support sample-domain `.mka`/`.mkv` concatenation across all single-stream owned audio formats. Three focused integration tests, 34 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Extend decode_audio, decode_audio_transformed, trim, normalize_loudness, and media_cli to support .f32le, .mka, and .mkv destinations across all owned fvid_media audio formats
entries.before: fvid::media::decode_audio, decode_audio_interval, and decode_audio_transformed check uses_native_audio_route and delegate directly to fvid_media::decode_audio_transformed for fvid_media audio sources (G.711 A-law/mu-law WAVE, Ogg Opus/Vorbis/Joint, bare FLAC/MP3, and secondary Matroska/MP4 tracks), failing on .f32le destinations for all those formats (`owned WAVE export requires .wav output` or `owned Matroska/MP4 audio export requires .wav, .mka or .mkv output`) and failing on .mka/.mkv destinations for G.711 WAVE, Ogg, and bare FLAC/MP3 (`owned WAVE export requires .wav output`); fvid::media::trim checks only .wav/.mka/.mkv for native_export and delegates to fvid_media::trim otherwise, failing on .f32le trims for all fvid_media audio formats and failing on .mka/.mkv trims for G.711 WAVE, Ogg, and bare FLAC/MP3; native_pcm::normalize_loudness_file_controlled checks matches!(ext, Some("wav" | "mka" | "mkv")) at entry and in native_plan::loudness, but its fvid_media export branch calls fvid_media::decode_audio_transformed directly and fails on .mka/.mkv outputs for G.711 WAVE, Ogg, and bare FLAC/MP3 (`owned WAVE export requires .wav output`); and src/media_cli.rs decode-audio rejects .f32le, .mka, and .mkv destinations for standalone G.711 WAVE, Ogg, bare FLAC, and bare MP3 inputs without `--features media` (`decode-audio works without legacy media tools only for owned audio sources writing .wav, .f32le, .mka, or .mkv`).
entries.result: Add decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination (with private SpoolWave) in src/media.rs so decode_audio, decode_audio_interval, and decode_audio_transformed decode non-.wav (.f32le, .mka, .mkv) fvid_media audio sources to a private temporary WAVE spool and publish the final destination via native_export::export_audio_pcm_transformed_with_controls; extend fvid::media::trim to route .f32le, .mka, and .mkv destinations across fvid_media audio sources after read-only fvid_media::plan_decode_audio admission; update native_pcm::normalize_loudness_file_controlled to use decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination so .mka and .mkv normalize-loudness outputs succeed across G.711 WAVE, Ogg, bare FLAC/MP3, and secondary Matroska/MP4 tracks; and include fvid_media::owned_container_loudness::recognizes_standalone_audio in src/media_cli.rs decode-audio admission so standalone owned audio formats can write .f32le, .mka, and .mkv without `--features media`. Three focused integration tests, 16 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Enforce packet, memory, and RSS budgets across decode_audio, trim, trim_pcm, loudness, normalize_loudness, and media_cli for all owned audio formats
entries.before: fvid::media::uses_native_audio_route returns Ok(true) even when options.max_controlled_bytes.is_some(), causing decode_audio_transformed and plan_decode_audio on PCM WAVE, ADTS, MP4, and Matroska to fail in validate_owned_audio_options (`native audio does not yet support requested allocation budget or metadata/stream mutations`) instead of delegating to fvid_media; fvid::media::trim_pcm, plan_trim_pcm, trim, plan_trim, measure_loudness, measure_loudness_with_weights, plan_loudness, plan_normalize_loudness, normalize_loudness, and normalize_loudness_controlled call validate_native_copy_options(options, true) and reject max_packets, max_packet_bytes, max_controlled_bytes, and max_rss_bytes (`native media operation does not yet support stream selection, custom budgets or metadata mutations`); native_pcm::loudness and native_pcm::normalize lack options-aware entrypoints; and src/media_cli.rs rejects --max-memory-mib in decode-audio and plan decode-audio and rejects --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-memory-mib, and --max-rss-mib in trim, trim-pcm, plan trim, plan trim-pcm, loudness, plan loudness, normalize-loudness, and plan normalize-loudness.
entries.result: Delegate fvid::media::uses_native_audio_route to fvid_media when options.max_controlled_bytes.is_some(); route trim_pcm and plan_trim_pcm with custom budgets/metadata to fvid_media::trim_pcm and fvid_media::plan_trim_pcm; add native_export::trim_audio_pcm_with_controls, native_pcm::measure_loudness_file_with_options, native_pcm::normalize_loudness_file_with_options, native_plan::loudness_with_options, and native_plan::normalize_loudness_with_options to enforce max_packets, max_packet_bytes, max_controlled_bytes, and max_rss_bytes across WAVE, ADTS, MP4, Matroska, G.711 WAVE, Ogg, and bare FLAC/MP3; and wire --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-memory-mib, and --max-rss-mib across decode-audio, plan decode-audio, trim, trim-pcm, plan trim, plan trim-pcm, loudness, plan loudness, normalize-loudness, and plan normalize-loudness in src/media_cli.rs. Three focused integration tests, 15 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Enforce packet, memory, and RSS budgets and metadata controls across remux, plan_remux, concat, plan_concat, and media_cli for WAVE, ADTS, MP4, Matroska, and sample-domain audio routes
entries.before: fvid::media::remux, plan_remux, concat, and plan_concat intercept linear PCM WAVE and ADTS inputs before fvid_media::remux/concat and call validate_native_copy_options(options, true), rejecting max_packets, max_packet_bytes, max_controlled_bytes, max_rss_bytes, metadata_set, and metadata_delete even though fvid_media::owned_wave_remux, owned_wave_plan, and owned_adts_remux implement those options for WAVE and Matroska ADTS outputs; native_export::remux_adts_aac, concat_adts_aac, and try_concat_mp4_matroska along with native_plan::remux, concat_adts, concat_matroska_to, and concat_mp4_matroska ignore or reject custom packet, memory, and RSS budgets for ADTS->MP4, MP4/Matroska packet-copy concat, and sample-domain audio concat; and src/media_cli.rs rejects --max-packet-bytes, --max-packets, --max-memory-mib, --max-rss-mib, --metadata, --metadata-delete, --stream-metadata, --stream-metadata-delete, and --quiet in remux, plan remux, concat, and plan concat without --features media.
entries.result: Delegate fvid::media::remux, plan_remux, concat, and plan_concat to fvid_media for WAVE inputs whenever custom budgets or WAVE INFO metadata edits are requested; add write_adts_aac_reader_limited and concat_adts_readers_limited (src/container/mp4_write.rs), open_with_packet_limit and write_limited (src/container/mp4_concat.rs), remux_adts_aac_with_options, concat_adts_aac_with_options, and try_concat_mp4_matroska_with_options (src/native_export.rs), concat_adts_with_options, concat_matroska_to_with_options, and concat_mp4_matroska_with_options (src/native_plan.rs), and eligible_with_options and concat_audio_with_options (src/native_audio_mix/concat.rs) to enforce max_packets, max_packet_bytes, max_controlled_bytes, and max_rss_bytes across ADTS, MP4, Matroska, and sample-domain audio concat; and wire budget and metadata flags into remux, plan remux, concat, and plan concat in src/media_cli.rs. Four focused integration tests, 44 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Enforce RSS and packet-byte budgets and metadata controls across owned lossless export, crop-lossless, overlay, xfade, burn-subtitles, and media_cli
entries.before: owned_lossless::policy rejects any CopyOptions with max_rss_bytes.is_some() (`request has no owned lossless export plan` / `owned Y4M lossless export does not yet implement requested policy`), and owned_mp4_video_bridge::prepare refuses MP4 video bridge whenever max_rss_bytes.is_some(), preventing transcode_lossless, plan_transcode_lossless, crop_lossless, overlay_video, and plan_overlay from honoring max_rss_bytes across Y4M, MP4, and Matroska; and src/media_cli.rs rejects --max-packet-bytes and --max-rss-mib in transcode-lossless and burn-subtitles, rejects crop-lossless with budget or metadata flags without --features media, rejects --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-rss-mib, --streams, and metadata flags in try_owned_overlay (`overlay` / `plan overlay`), and rejects --max-packet-bytes in owned_xfade_command.
entries.result: Allow max_rss_bytes in owned_lossless::policy and owned_mp4_video_bridge::prepare and enforce owned_budget::check_rss_budget(options) across owned_lossless (plan_transcode_lossless and transcode_lossless), owned_ffv1_export, owned_matroska::export_y4m_ffv1_policy, owned_mp4_video_decode, owned_mp4_video_bridge, owned_mp4_multitrack_export, and owned_webm_multitrack_export; extend owned_lossless_command in src/media_cli.rs to accept crop-lossless (preserving --crop requirement and non-crop transform refusals), --max-packet-bytes, --max-rss-mib, and --overlay/--overlay-x/--overlay-y; extend try_owned_overlay to accept --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-rss-mib, --streams, and metadata flags and delegate controlled overlay plans/exports to fvid::media::plan_overlay and overlay_video; and wire --max-packet-bytes and --max-rss-mib into owned_xfade_command and owned_subtitle_burn_command. One focused integration test, 53 related unit and integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Enforce budgets and metadata controls across Y4M export/concat/trim, burn-subtitles, xfade, and media_cli
entries.before: fvid::media::trim, plan_trim_y4m, concat, and plan_concat_y4m call validate_native_copy_options(options, true) and reject max_packets, max_packet_bytes, and max_rss_bytes for Y4M outputs (`native media operation does not yet support stream selection, custom budgets or metadata mutations`); native_export::export_y4m_pipeline, concat_y4m, trim_y4m, and export_y4m_sources ignore packet and RSS budgets; owned_subtitle_burn::default_policy rejects metadata_set, metadata_delete, stream_metadata_set, and stream_metadata_delete and writes Matroska FFV1 without container or stream tags; owned_xfade::default_policy rejects explicit single-video-stream selection (`options.streams == [0]`) and plan_xfade skips check_rss_budget(options); and src/media_cli.rs rejects --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-rss-mib, --quiet, and --progress in export-y4m, try_video_concat, and try_video_trim, rejects --streams in owned_xfade_command, and rejects --metadata, --metadata-delete, --stream-metadata, and --stream-metadata-delete in owned_subtitle_burn_command.
entries.result: Add validate_y4m_options, export_y4m_pipeline_with_options, concat_y4m_with_options, trim_y4m_with_options, and export_y4m_sources_with_options in src/native_export.rs plus concat_y4m_with_options and trim_y4m_with_options in src/native_plan.rs and wire fvid::media::trim, plan_trim_y4m, concat, and plan_concat_y4m to enforce max_packets, max_packet_bytes, and max_rss_bytes; extend owned_subtitle_burn (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_subtitle_burn.rs`) to accept container and stream metadata mutations, enforce max_packet_bytes != 0, and write container/stream tags via PacketWriter::new_ffv1_with_track_description; extend owned_xfade (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_xfade.rs`) to allow options.streams == [0], enforce max_packet_bytes != 0, and run check_rss_budget(options) in plan_xfade; and wire budget/progress flags into export-y4m, try_video_concat, and try_video_trim, --streams into owned_xfade_command, and metadata flags into owned_subtitle_burn_command in src/media_cli.rs. One focused integration test, 36 related unit and integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Enforce packet, memory, and RSS budgets, cancellation, and progress controls across native_audio_mix, native_subtitle, owned_subtitle, and media_cli
entries.before: native_audio_mix provides only uncontrolled eligible, plan, mix_audio, plan_merge, and merge_audio plus cancel-only mix_audio_cancelled and merge_audio_cancelled, offering no CopyOptions controls for max_packets, max_packet_bytes, max_controlled_bytes, max_rss_bytes, or progress reporting; owned_subtitle_impl::try_convert (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_subtitle_impl.rs`) hardcodes DEFAULT_MAX_PACKET_BYTES and provides no packet-count, RSS-budget, cancellation, or progress controls across SRT, ASS, and Matroska subtitle conversions; and src/media_cli.rs rejects --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-memory-mib, --max-rss-mib, and --progress in mix-audio, plan mix-audio, merge-audio, and plan merge-audio (`this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media`) and rejects --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-rss-mib, and --progress in convert-subtitles.
entries.result: Add eligible_with_options, plan_with_controls, mix_audio_with_controls, plan_merge_with_controls, and merge_audio_with_controls in src/native_audio_mix.rs enforcing max_packets, max_packet_bytes, max_controlled_bytes, max_rss_bytes, cancel, and progress across mix-audio and merge-audio; add try_convert_controlled in crates/fvid-media/src/owned_subtitle_impl.rs (included by crates/fvid-media/src/owned_subtitle.rs and src/native_subtitle.rs) enforcing max_packet_bytes, max_packets, max_rss_bytes, cancel, and progress across SRT, ASS, and Matroska subtitle conversion; and wire --max-packets, --max-packet-bytes, --max-memory-mib, --max-rss-mib, --progress, and -q/--quiet into native_mix, native_merge, and convert-subtitles in src/media_cli.rs. One focused integration test, 19 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Enforce RSS budgets and metadata/stream controls across MP4, Matroska, and ADTS remux, plan_remux, concat, and plan_concat
entries.before: owned_mp4_remux::policies and owned_matroska_remux::unedited_policies require options.max_rss_bytes.is_none(), refusing any MP4->Matroska or Matroska->Matroska remux or plan_remux whenever max_rss_bytes is set; owned_adts_remux::remux and concat, owned_concat::concat and plan_concat, and owned_remux_plan::plan_remux do not enforce owned_budget::check_rss_budget(options); fvid::media::validate_matroska_copy_options rejects max_rss_bytes; and fvid::media::plan_remux calls validate_native_copy_options(options, true) before delegating MP4 sources with custom budgets or container/stream metadata edits to fvid_media::plan_remux (`native media operation does not yet support stream selection, custom budgets or metadata mutations`).
entries.result: Replace options.max_rss_bytes.is_none() in owned_mp4_remux::policies and owned_matroska_remux::unedited_policies with crate::owned_budget::check_rss_budget(options).is_ok() and enforce check_rss_budget(options) in owned_mp4_remux::remux and plan_remux, owned_matroska_remux::remux and publish, owned_adts_remux::remux and concat, owned_concat::concat and plan_concat, and owned_remux_plan::plan_remux; update fvid::media::validate_matroska_copy_options to enforce fvid_media::owned_budget::check_rss_budget(options) and admit max_rss_bytes; and route fvid::media::plan_remux to fvid_media::plan_remux for MP4 sources when custom packet/RSS budgets or container/stream metadata mutations are requested while preserving bare stream-selection refusal on destination-less MP4 fast-start plans. One focused integration test, 33 related integration tests, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Route WAVE INFO metadata mutations across decode-audio and trim and expose controlled mix/merge audio in fvid::media and media_cli
entries.before: fvid::media::uses_native_audio_route, trim, and plan_trim do not check whether container/stream metadata mutations are requested before dispatching to native_export / native_plan, causing decode_audio, decode_audio_transformed, plan_decode_audio, trim, and plan_trim on WAVE, ADTS, MP4, and Matroska sources to fail in validate_owned_audio_options (`native audio does not yet support requested allocation budget or metadata/stream mutations`) instead of delegating WAVE INFO tag edits to fvid_media; fvid::media lacks public mix_audio_with_controls, plan_mix_audio_with_controls, merge_audio_with_controls, and plan_merge_audio_with_controls entry points; and src/media_cli.rs rejects --metadata and --metadata-delete in decode-audio, plan decode-audio, trim, plan trim, trim-pcm, and plan trim-pcm without --features media.
entries.result: Route fvid::media::uses_native_audio_route, trim, and plan_trim to fvid_media::decode_audio_transformed, plan_decode_audio, trim, and plan_trim when container/stream metadata mutations are requested (while continuing to reject metadata mutations on headerless .f32le or Matroska PCM audio decode destinations in decode_fvid_media_audio_to_destination); add public fvid::media::mix_audio_with_controls, plan_mix_audio_with_controls, merge_audio_with_controls, and plan_merge_audio_with_controls delegating through native_audio_mix; and wire --metadata and --metadata-delete into decode-audio, plan decode-audio, and try_native_audio_trim (`trim`, `plan trim`, `trim-pcm`, `plan trim-pcm`) plus controlled mix/merge calls in src/media_cli.rs. entries.title: Preserve and mutate WAVE INFO metadata across loudnorm and normalize-loudness and route fvid::media::{plan_loudnorm, apply_loudnorm, apply_loudnorm_dual} through native_loudnorm

entries.before: In default builds without `--features media`, `fvid media decode` (`src/media_cli.rs`) strips only `--framestep` and spatial/pixel filters before `plain_decode`, so passing `--shuffleframes`, `--reverse`, or `--input-format` falls through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` even though `fvid::media::decode_video_transformed` already owns them across Y4M, Matroska, and MP4. In addition, `owned_y4m_decode::decode_reader_transformed` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_y4m_decode.rs`) and `owned_video_decode::decode_webm` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_video_decode.rs`) return `Ok(DecodeStats { video_frames: 0, .. })` on 0-frame inputs or when `--framestep`/`--shuffleframes`/`--reverse` drops all frames, and `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_lossless.rs`) under default `CopyOptions` skips checking whether a Y4M source contains at least one frame.
entries.result: Add `try_owned_decode_command` in `src/media_cli.rs` to route `fvid media decode` with `--shuffleframes`, `--reverse`, `--input-format`, and all owned `DecodeTransform` flags through `fvid::media::decode_video_transformed`, reject `consumed == 0` or 0-emitted-frame temporal filter decodes in `owned_y4m_decode::decode_reader_transformed` and `owned_video_decode::decode_webm` with `"input has no decoded video frames"`, and verify first-frame presence in `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` on Y4M sources under default `CopyOptions`. entries.title: Validate post-compositing pixel filters against post-geometry frames in native overlay and decode-overlay planning and record rotate in CLI overlay geometry plan steps

As a result, `fvid media plan overlay` and `fvid media plan decode --overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`) accept incompatible pixel filters (such as oversized `boxblur` radius `lr=10` on 8x4 YUV420 or `deband` with `coupling=1` on 4:2:0) that fail at execution time, and `try_owned_overlay` in `src/media_cli.rs` omits `rotate` from the `geometry` plan step detail for `plan overlay`.
entries.result: Add `TimedOverlay::validate_pair_with_geometry_and_filters` (`src/native_export/overlay.rs`), `overlay_with_geometry_and_filters` and `decode_overlay_with_geometry_and_filters` (`src/native_plan.rs`), and wire them through `native_plan::transcode_lossless` and `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`), while including `rotate` in the `plan overlay` geometry step detail. entries.title: Update native decode pixel_format and Y4M export preflight packet budget after cross-plane shuffleplanes subsampling promotion and reject --rotate in CLI crop-lossless fallback
entries.before: In `decode_video_pipeline_overlay_step` (`src/native_media.rs`), `stats.pixel_format` is updated for `geometry.transpose` but is not recomputed from `output.subsampling` after `filters.apply_colour_clock(...)`. When cross-plane `shuffleplanes` (e.g. `"1:2:0"`) promotes a 4:2:0 or 4:2:2 frame to 4:4:4 (`Some([1, 1])`), `fvid::native_media::decode_video_request` and `fvid media decode` report `"yuv420p"` instead of `"yuv444p"`. In addition, `export_y4m_sources_with_options` (`src/native_export.rs`) validates the Y4M output frame byte budget with `inspect_first_y4m_frame(source, geometry)` without `filters`, so a promoted 4:4:4 Y4M frame (96 bytes on 8x4 vs 48 bytes raw 4:2:0) bypasses preflight `--max-packet-bytes` validation; and the CLI `crop-lossless` fallback check (`src/media_cli.rs`) omits `(geometry.rotate.is_some(), "--rotate")` and `filters.canonicalize_option_order()`.
entries.result: Recompute `pixel_format` from `output.subsampling` after `filters.apply_colour_clock(...)` in `decode_video_pipeline_overlay_step` (`src/native_media.rs`), add `inspect_first_y4m_frame_with_filters` and `validate_video_packet_budget_with_geometry_filters_interval_and_limit` (`src/native_export.rs`) and call them in `export_y4m_sources_with_options`, and reject `--rotate` alongside `--scale`/`--transpose`/`--pad` in the `crop-lossless` fallback check (`src/media_cli.rs`). entries.title: Validate first-frame geometry and pixel filters on Y4M inputs in owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless under default packet budgets
entries.before: In `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_lossless.rs`), when `options` uses default packet limits (`options.max_packets.is_none()` and default `options.max_packet_bytes`) and no temporal filter (`interval`, `framestep`, `shuffleframes`, `reverse`) is active, the Y4M planning branch only reads two lines (`header` and `FRAME\n`) and skips validating `requested_geometry`, `overlay`, and `apply_pixel_filters_clock` on the first frame. Consequently, calling `plan_transcode_lossless` on a Y4M source with metadata or stream-selection options (e.g. `--metadata title=test`) or on a default-FPS Y4M source without an explicit `F` header token accepts out-of-bounds `--crop` rectangles and oversized `--boxblur` radii that fail at execution time.
entries.result: Validate the first transformed Y4M frame through `visit_reader_transformed_counted` in the default-packet-budget branch of `owned_lossless::plan_transcode_lossless` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_lossless.rs`), and remove the duplicate `transform.unsharp.is_some()` guard in `owned_y4m_decode::apply_pixel_filters_clock` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_y4m_decode.rs`). entries.title: Scan ADTS packets and include Matroska packet-budget step in native_plan::remux_with_options and route CLI plan transcode --encoder ffv1 and shorthand plan INPUT in default builds
entries.before: In `native_plan::remux_with_options` (`src/native_plan.rs`), ADTS inputs only inspect the first 8-byte signature via `native_probe::probe` without scanning packets through `container::adts::StreamReader`, and Matroska inputs omit the `budget` plan step (`FVid maximum encoded packet size: N bytes`) that `fvid::media::plan_remux` (`src/media.rs`) appends manually. As a result, `fvid::native_plan::remux` and `fvid media plan remux` accept ADTS files with truncated or corrupt packets after the first frame and produce Matroska remux plans that diverge from `fvid::media::plan_remux`. In addition, `src/media_cli.rs` rewrites `fvid media transcode INPUT OUTPUT --encoder ffv1` to `transcode-lossless` in default builds without `--features media`, but does not rewrite `fvid media plan transcode INPUT --encoder ffv1` or shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT [--crop ...]`.
entries.result: Scan ADTS packets with `container::adts::StreamReader::open_with_packet_limit` and include the Matroska `budget` step directly in `native_plan::remux_with_options` (`src/native_plan.rs`), unify default-option ADTS and Matroska planning in `fvid::media::plan_remux` (`src/media.rs`), and route `fvid media plan transcode INPUT --encoder ffv1` and shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT` in `src/media_cli.rs` in default builds without `--features media`. entries.title: Reject encoder selection on CLI media plan and reject duplicate or unknown options on CLI overlay and plan overlay
entries.before: In default builds without `--features media`, `src/media_cli.rs` rewrites `fvid media plan transcode INPUT --encoder ffv1` and shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT` without first enforcing `run_native`'s rule that `fvid media plan` rejects `--encoder`, `--encoder-option`, and shorthand metadata-mutation flags (`--metadata`, `--metadata-delete`, `--stream-metadata`, `--stream-metadata-delete`) with `"plan does not take metadata mutation or encoder selection"`. entries.result: Reject `--encoder` and `--encoder-option` on `fvid media plan` and reject metadata mutation flags on shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT` in `src/media_cli.rs` with `"plan does not take metadata mutation or encoder selection"`, and reject duplicate `--overlay`, `--overlay-x`, and `--overlay-y` flags and unknown `--...` flags in `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`) with explicit diagnostic errors. entries.title: Validate positional path arity and flag-prefixed destinations in owned lossless, xfade, and burn-subtitles CLI commands and ignore --progress across owned plan subcommands
entries.before: In `src/media_cli.rs`, `owned_lossless_command_with_name`, `owned_xfade_command`, `owned_subtitle_burn_command`, and the native `transcode-lossless` / `crop-lossless` fast path index positional paths (`args[1..required]`) without checking whether a flag (`--quiet`, `--crop`, etc.) appears where a destination path is required or whether extra positional paths appear after `args[required..]`. Consequently, `fvid media transcode-lossless INPUT --quiet` treats `--quiet` as the destination path `args[2]` and writes a Matroska file literally named `--quiet` in the current working directory, while extra positional arguments (`INPUT OUTPUT EXTRA`) return `Ok(false)` and fall through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"`. In addition, `plan remux`, `plan normalize-loudness`, `plan trim`, `plan trim-pcm`, `plan mix-audio`, `plan merge-audio`, and `plan concat` reject `--progress` instead of ignoring it during planning like `run_native` and `plan transcode-lossless`.
entries.result: Validate positional path arity and reject `-`-prefixed positional slots or extra positional arguments in `owned_lossless_command_with_name`, `owned_xfade_command`, `owned_subtitle_burn_command`, and the native `transcode-lossless`/`crop-lossless` fast path (`src/media_cli.rs`), and accept and ignore `--progress` during planning across `plan remux`, `plan normalize-loudness`, `plan trim`, `plan trim-pcm`, `plan mix-audio`, `plan merge-audio`, and `plan concat`. entries.title: Support optional destination path and destination-specific metadata validation in CLI plan loudnorm and enforce positional path arity in owned_loudnorm_cli
entries.before: In `owned_loudnorm_cli::run` and `owned_loudnorm_cli::run_plan` (`src/owned_loudnorm_cli.rs`) and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`), `fvid media plan loudnorm` rejects an optional destination path `INPUT [OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv]` (`"unsupported loudnorm plan option: planned-out.mka"`), unlike `fvid media plan normalize-loudness INPUT [OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv]`. Consequently, callers cannot validate destination-specific rules during `plan loudnorm` (such as rejecting `--stream-metadata` or non-RIFF-INFO container keys when the planned destination is `.wav`, or rejecting unsupported output extensions like `.mp3`). In addition, `owned_loudnorm_cli::run` and `run_plan` index `args[1]` and `args[2]` without checking whether a `--...` flag occupies a required positional slot or whether extra positional paths appear.
entries.result: Parse positional paths and flags cleanly in `owned_loudnorm_cli::run` and `owned_loudnorm_cli::run_plan` (`src/owned_loudnorm_cli.rs`) and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`), accept an optional destination path `INPUT [OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv]` in `plan loudnorm`, and validate the destination extension (`.wav`, `.mka`, `.mkv`) and `.wav` RIFF INFO metadata constraints before planning or executing loudnorm. Two focused integration tests, 4 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Separate container route qualification from packet-budget enforcement in native_loudnorm::try_plan and try_apply
entries.before: In `native_loudnorm::try_plan` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs:233-237`) and `native_loudnorm::try_apply` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs:526-529`), route qualification passes `options` (including `max_packet_bytes` and `max_packets`) into `is_owned_audio_trim_source_with_options` and `audio_source_info_selected_with_options(...).is_ok()`. When a caller configures a tight packet byte budget (`max_packet_bytes: 1`) on a multi-track MP4 container without an explicit `--streams` selection (`tests/fixtures/playback-errors/alac-two-tracks.m4a`), `audio_source_info_selected_with_options` fails with `"MP4 packet exceeds budget"`, which causes `.is_ok()` to evaluate to `false` and `try_plan`/`try_apply` to fall through to `owned_container_loudnorm::supports_plan` (which returns `false` on multi-track MP4 without explicit stream selection) and return `Ok(None)` instead of propagating `Err("MP4 packet exceeds budget")`.
entries.result: Qualify native container and codec eligibility in `native_loudnorm::try_plan` and `native_loudnorm::try_apply` (`src/native_loudnorm.rs`) using default packet limits while preserving stream selection and cancellation, so subsequent execution and plan checks propagate `"MP4 packet exceeds budget"` and `"WebM packet exceeds budget"` errors cleanly instead of returning `Ok(None)`. Nine focused integration tests in `tests/native_loudnorm_cli.rs`, 5 related tests across 4 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Allow controlled memory budgets alongside Matroska metadata mutations in decode_audio and trim and support destination-aware CLI planning for decode-audio and trim

entries.title: Support destination-aware CLI planning and flexible argument ordering in plan remux, remux, plan loudness, and loudness
entries.before: In `media_cli::run` and `media_cli::run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`), `plan remux`, `remux`, `plan loudness`, and `loudness` assume fixed positional indexing (`args[1]` / `args[2]`), so passing flags before positional paths (`fvid media plan remux --quiet INPUT`, `fvid media plan loudness --quiet INPUT`, `fvid media loudness --quiet INPUT`) or omitting `INPUT` treats the flag as a path or fails with `"unsupported remux plan option"`. entries.title: Support flexible argument ordering and destination-aware metadata validation in CLI concat and plan concat
entries.before: In `try_native_audio_concat`, `try_video_concat`, and `try_mp4_matroska_concat` (`src/media_cli.rs`), CLI `concat` and `plan concat` assume fixed positional indexing (`args[command + 1]` / `args[command + 2]`), so passing flags before positional paths (`fvid media plan concat --quiet --max-packets 2 a.wav b.wav`, `fvid media concat --quiet out.wav a.wav b.wav`) fails with `No such file or directory (os error 2)` or returns `Ok(false)` and falls through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds. entries.title: Preserve packet-budget, extension, and option validation diagnostics in CLI mix-audio, merge-audio, convert-subtitles, and plan convert-subtitles

entries.title: Enforce .y4m destination extension in export_y4m_pipeline_with_options and support flexible flag ordering and direct diagnostics in export-y4m, transcode-lossless, crop-lossless, xfade, and burn-subtitles CLI

entries.title: Support flexible flag ordering and direct diagnostics in CLI transcode, transcode-lossless, and crop-lossless
entries.before: In `src/media_cli.rs:32-72`, `fvid media transcode` requires `args.len() >= 5` and fixed positional indices `args[1]` (`INPUT`) and `args[2]` (`OUTPUT`) before flags, so leading flags (`fvid media transcode --quiet --encoder ffv1 --encoder-option level=1 --hflip in.y4m out.mkv`), missing positional arguments, or missing `--encoder` when fewer than 5 arguments are passed skip the `transcode` branch and fail in default builds with `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"`. In addition, unknown flags in `transcode-lossless` and `crop-lossless` (`src/media_cli.rs:804-830` and `owned_lossless_command_with_name` at `6977-6988`) return `Ok(false)` and fall through to the `media` feature-gate message in default builds.
entries.result: Update `transcode` argument parsing (`src/media_cli.rs:32-73`) to accept flags and positional `INPUT`/`OUTPUT` paths in any order, report direct errors on missing paths (`"transcode requires INPUT OUTPUT --encoder NAME"`), missing `--encoder` (`"transcode requires --encoder; quality is defined by its options"`), or unsupported encoders, and reject unknown flags in `transcode-lossless` and `crop-lossless` with `"unsupported <command> option: <flag>"` in default builds. Eleven focused integration tests, 8 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Support flexible flag ordering and direct diagnostics in CLI shorthand plan and decode
entries.before: In `src/media_cli.rs:74-128`, shorthand `fvid media plan INPUT [flags]` requires `args.len() >= 2` and `!args[1].starts_with('-')`, so leading flags (`fvid media plan --quiet --hflip in.y4m`, `fvid media plan --metadata title=Bad in.y4m`) or missing `INPUT` (`fvid media plan`, `fvid media plan --quiet`) skip the shorthand `plan` handler and fall through to `"this media operation requires cargo build --release --features media"` in default builds. In addition, in `try_owned_decode_command` (`src/media_cli.rs:7948-8153`), missing `INPUT` (`fvid media decode`, `fvid media decode --quiet`), extra positional arguments, or unknown flags (`fvid media decode in.y4m --bogus-flag`) return `Ok(false)` and fall through to the `media` feature-gate message in default builds.
entries.result: Update shorthand `plan` argument parsing (`src/media_cli.rs:74-157`) to accept flags and positional `INPUT` in any order and report direct diagnostics on missing/extra `INPUT` or metadata flags, and update `try_owned_decode_command` (`src/media_cli.rs:7978-8178`) to report direct errors on missing/extra `INPUT` (`"decode requires a single INPUT"`) or unknown options (`"unsupported decode option: <flag>"`) in default builds. Eleven focused integration tests, 8 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Support destination-aware planning (`[OUTPUT]` and `--output-format`) in CLI `plan mix-audio` and `plan merge-audio`
entries.before: In `native_mix` (`src/media_cli.rs:5971-6104`), `native_merge` (`src/media_cli.rs:6106-6219`), and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs:4260-4282`), `plan mix-audio` and `plan merge-audio` do not accept an optional destination path `OUTPUT` (`[OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv] INPUT INPUT...`) or `--output-format`, unlike `plan remux`, `plan trim`, `plan decode-audio`, `plan normalize-loudness`, and `plan loudnorm`. Passing a destination path to `plan mix-audio` treats `OUTPUT` as the first input source and fails with `No such file or directory`, passing a destination path to `plan merge-audio` fails with `"merge-audio requires exactly two inputs"`, and `.wav`-incompatible metadata mutations (`--stream-metadata`, non-RIFF-INFO container keys) cannot be validated against a planned `.wav` destination.
entries.result: Add `resolve_plan_mix_or_merge_destination` and `--output-format` support in `native_mix`, `native_merge`, and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`) so `plan mix-audio` and `plan merge-audio` accept an optional leading `OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv` or `--output-format wav|mka|mkv|matroska`, validate `.wav` vs Matroska metadata rules before planning, and reject unsupported output formats or extensions cleanly. One focused integration test suite, 18 related tests across 3 suites, and 1 offline fixture unit test pass.

entries.title: Support destination-aware planning ([OUTPUT] and --output-format) across CLI plan concat handlers
entries.before: In `try_native_audio_concat` (`src/media_cli.rs:5507-5723`), `try_video_concat` (`src/media_cli.rs:5725-5849`), `try_mp4_matroska_concat` (`src/media_cli.rs:6365-6557`), and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs:4075-4083`), `fvid media plan concat` does not accept an optional leading destination path `OUTPUT` (`[OUTPUT.wav|OUTPUT.mka|OUTPUT.mkv|OUTPUT.mp4|OUTPUT.m4a|OUTPUT.y4m] INPUT INPUT...`), and `try_native_audio_concat` and `run_native` do not accept `--output-format`. Passing a leading destination path to `plan concat` treats `OUTPUT` as the first input source and fails with `No such file or directory`, and destination-specific metadata constraints (such as `.wav` rejecting `--stream-metadata` and non-RIFF-INFO container keys, or `.mp4`/`.m4a` rejecting metadata mutations) are not enforced when planning with an explicit destination path or `--output-format m4a|mp4`.
entries.result: Add `resolve_plan_concat_destination` and `--output-format` support across `try_mp4_matroska_concat`, `try_video_concat`, `try_native_audio_concat`, and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`) so `plan concat` accepts an optional leading destination path or `--output-format wav|mka|mkv|matroska|mp4|m4a|y4m`, validates `.wav` and `.mp4`/`.m4a` metadata rules before planning, and rejects unsupported destination formats or extensions cleanly. Five focused integration tests, 14 related tests across 3 suites, and 2 offline fixture unit tests pass.

entries.title: Enforce .mkv output extension across owned FFV1 lossless export, overlay, xfade, and subtitle burn-in and preserve crop-lossless plan diagnostics
entries.before: In `fvid_media::owned_lossless::transcode_lossless` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_lossless.rs`), `fvid_media::owned_xfade::xfade_video` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_xfade.rs`), `fvid_media::owned_subtitle_burn::burn_subtitles` (`crates/fvid-media/src/owned_subtitle_burn.rs`), and CLI `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`), non-`.mkv` destination paths (such as `out.mp4`) are not rejected when routed through the `fvid_media::owned_lossless` / `owned_xfade` / `owned_subtitle_burn` paths, silently writing Matroska FFV1 containers to non-`.mkv` filenames. In addition, `owned_lossless_command_with_name` (`src/media_cli.rs:7337`) hardcodes `"plan transcode-lossless requires a single INPUT"` even when invoked for `plan crop-lossless`.
entries.result: Validate `.mkv` destination extensions up front across `fvid_media::owned_lossless::transcode_lossless`, `fvid_media::owned_xfade::xfade_video`, `fvid_media::owned_subtitle_burn::burn_subtitles`, and `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs`), route `try_owned_overlay` through `fvid_media::owned_lossless` when temporal flags (`--from`, `--to`, `--framestep`, `--reverse`, `--shuffleframes`) or non-`overlay_eligible` sources supported by `owned_lossless` are used, and preserve the `plan crop-lossless requires a single INPUT` diagnostic in `owned_lossless_command_with_name`. Twelve focused integration tests pass.

entries.title: Support destination-aware planning ([OUTPUT.mkv] and --output-format) across CLI plan transcode-lossless, crop-lossless, overlay, xfade, and burn-subtitles
entries.before: In `owned_lossless_command_with_name` (`src/media_cli.rs:7314-7326`), `try_owned_overlay` (`src/media_cli.rs:6809-6829`), `owned_xfade_command` (`src/media_cli.rs:7508-7514`), `owned_subtitle_burn_command` (`src/media_cli.rs:7635-7647`), and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs:4131-4199`), `fvid media plan transcode-lossless`, `plan crop-lossless`, `plan overlay`, `plan xfade`, and `plan burn-subtitles` reject an optional `OUTPUT.mkv` destination path with arity errors and reject `--output-format` with `unsupported <cmd> option: --output-format` or `unknown media option: --output-format`, unlike `plan remux`, `plan trim`, `plan trim-pcm`, `plan decode-audio`, `plan normalize-loudness`, `plan loudnorm`, `plan convert-subtitles`, `plan mix-audio`, `plan merge-audio`, and `plan concat`.
entries.result: Accept an optional trailing `OUTPUT.mkv` destination path and `--output-format mkv|matroska` during planning across `owned_lossless_command_with_name`, `try_owned_overlay`, `owned_xfade_command`, `owned_subtitle_burn_command`, and `run_native` (`src/media_cli.rs`), rejecting non-`.mkv` destination extensions or output formats with `"owned FFV1 export requires .mkv"` without creating files. entries.title: Support --output-format across CLI plan remux, trim, trim-pcm, decode-audio, normalize-loudness, loudnorm, and convert-subtitles and optional OUTPUT.y4m in Y4M plan trim
entries.before: In `src/media_cli.rs` and `src/owned_loudnorm_cli.rs`, `fvid media plan remux`, `plan trim`, `plan trim-pcm`, `plan decode-audio`, `plan normalize-loudness`, `plan loudnorm`, and `plan convert-subtitles` reject `--output-format FORMAT` with `unsupported <cmd> plan option: --output-format` or `unknown media option: --output-format`, unlike `plan concat`, `plan mix-audio`, `plan merge-audio`, and the FFV1 export plan commands. entries.result: Support `--output-format` during planning across `plan remux`, `plan trim`, `plan trim-pcm`, `plan decode-audio`, `plan normalize-loudness`, `plan loudnorm`, and `plan convert-subtitles` in `src/media_cli.rs` and `src/owned_loudnorm_cli.rs`, validating destination-specific metadata constraints (`.wav`, `.f32le`, `.mp4`/`.m4a`, `.mkv`) before planning, and accept an optional `OUTPUT.y4m` destination path in `try_video_trim` during planning.
